_about: All detector tunables in one place. Hardware limits and baselines are NOT here: they live in topology.enriched.json (metricCatalog, baselines).

CFG._min_confidence: samples with quality.confidence below this are ignored
CFG._persist: a deviation must last at least persist_s seconds AND persist_min_samples samples before it flags
CFG._baseline_frac: fallback only: if no stored baseline exists, the first 25% of the window is used as the baseline
CFG._robust_z: robust z-score cut-off (how many robust standard deviations from the baseline median)
CFG._peer_z: cut-off for a GPU vs the median of the other GPUs on the same job
CFG._cusum: CUSUM = running total of small deviations. k = slack ignored per sample, h = alarm level, both in standard deviations. min_drift_c = smallest drift worth flagging
CFG._poisson: error-counter test: flag if this many errors in rate_window_s would happen by chance with probability below poisson_p
CFG._maintenance_grace_s: how long after a maintenance window closes an entity may still be coming back
CFG._intervention_grace_s: slack either side of an intervention's active window
CFG._frozen_samples: a gauge repeating the exact same value this many times in a row counts as frozen
CFG._frozen_p: ...and only if a repeat run that long would happen by chance with probability below this, given how often that signal normally repeats
CFG._liveness: training is stalled if no step completes for max(liveness_min_s, liveness_step_multiple x normal step time)
CFG._checkpoint_overrun_multiple: time budget for the checkpoint gate: a checkpoint may take this many times its expected duration
CFG._hampel: spike filter: a sample further than hampel_sigma robust standard deviations from the median of its 2*hampel_k neighbours is replaced

_ROBUST: metric -> [bad direction, minimum relative change, spread floor as a fraction of the baseline median]
_RATE_FLOOR_PER_MIN: error counter -> smallest background rate (per minute) the Poisson test will assume, even if the measured baseline rate is lower
_PEER: metric -> [minimum absolute difference from peers, spread floor]
_LAYER: root-cause ranking: lower number = closer to the facility, preferred as root cause when findings are merged
